ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.RachunkiBankoweVat') and name=N'RBVRkb' ) BEGIN INSERT INTO #XLIndexesFileGroups SELECT IND.name,FG.name FROM sys.indexes IND JOIN sys.filegroups FG ON FG.data_space_id = IND.data_space_id WHERE IND.name = 'RBVRkb' DROP INDEX RBVRkb on CDN.RachunkiBankoweVat; END
